rules: Federation civil presentation must remain distinct from Starfleet military/service presentation.
Civil offices, diplomatic venues and council contexts prioritize institutional clarity, accessibility and member-world plurality.
Species/culture presentation remains independent; civil affiliation does not standardize faces or personal clothing outside actual dress rules.
Exact insignia, architecture and formal dress require era/source-specific references before production lock.
allowed_variation: member-world cultural clothing when context allows
forbidden_variation: Starfleet uniform as generic Federation clothing
military rank pips on civilians without real service state
one Human-centric visual default for Federation government
